## Roadmap status

Use **Roadmap Status** to distinguish:

- **Completed Phase** — closed work retained for history.
- **Next Executable Phase** — the next phase whose dependencies and entry conditions are satisfied.
- **Future Roadmap** — confirmed goals that depend on earlier work.
- **Backlog** — valid work with unresolved owner choices or no current phase commitment.

Keep **Status** for issue progress and **Priority** for P0–P3. New phase names and dependency edges are recorded below and in each issue’s `PROPOSED_PHASE` / `DEPENDENCIES`; the existing Phase 0–3 values remain the historical PR-1/security phase labels.

## Roadmap Delta — KIRARI Edge Gateway (2026-10-02)

### Historical implementation and current caller evidence

The archived [KIRARI-GHCard-Cache](https://github.com/markd3ng/KIRARI-GHCard-Cache) is a historical reference implementation, not an unrelated project. Its [architecture](https://github.com/markd3ng/KIRARI-GHCard-Cache/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and [KIRARI integration guide](https://github.com/markd3ng/KIRARI-GHCard-Cache/blob/main/docs/KIRARI_INTEGRATION.md) define reusable contracts. Its final `main` commit is `b7fecbbe8120c64de9cfa1557273656beab8d02d` (2026-07-01). It implemented strict GitHub repo metadata, contents, latest-by-path commit, and avatar routes; per-kind TTLs; stale fallback; bounded responses; rate-limit visibility; health checks; REST-only token use; Cloudflare Cache API + KV and Vercel Runtime Cache/HTTP cache adapters.

Current Site source confirms active GitHub Card calls for repository metadata, contents, latest commit by path, and avatar fallback. The Bangumi page currently calls user collections and consumes nested subject/image data from that response; it does not call a separate subject endpoint. The Cravatar `/avatar` proxy and standalone `/api/bangumi` and `/images/bangumi` proxy flags have no current Site caller and remain disabled. Separate `avatar.resolve`, `bangumi.subject`, and `bangumi.image` operations are candidates only if a caller or owner decision demonstrates need.

The current Worker fixes upstream hosts but forwards arbitrary suffixes under enabled prefixes. The target remains a **KIRARI Edge Gateway, not a general-purpose reverse proxy**: no user-controlled upstream URL, no arbitrary path forwarding, and no unregistered upstream capability.

### Architecture and migration target

- Target package boundary: `apps/edge-gateway/`; no directory migration is part of this roadmap correction.
- Use a portable core over Web `Request`, `Response`, and `fetch`; keep runtime handlers, routing, secret bindings, cache backends, and platform packaging in adapters.
- Proposed capability namespace: `/_kirari/edge/*`, with named operations such as `github.repository`, `github.contents`, `github.latestCommit`, `github.avatar`, and the currently active `bangumi.userCollections`. Old `/ghc/*` paths are not promised permanent compatibility.
- Define `EdgeCache` and `PersistentCache` with `CACHE_NONE`, `CACHE_EDGE`, and `CACHE_PERSISTENT`. Each adapter documents its own scope, consistency, invalidation, TTL, and downgrade behavior; these platforms do not provide identical cache semantics.
- **Integrated mode (default):** Site and Gateway share the same application/deployment boundary and Site calls the same-origin `/_kirari/edge/*` path.
- **Standalone mode:** `edge.example.com` may serve one or more Sites; configure exact allowed origins, separate deployment/cache/secret lifecycle, and health/operations explicitly.
- Site configuration may express `enabled`, a base path such as `/_kirari/edge`, and feature flags. It must not select Cloudflare, Vercel, or EdgeOne behavior.

GHCardCache migration: **KEEP** strict named GitHub routes, parameter/size/query validation, read-only requests, per-resource TTL, success/short-404 cache rules, stale fallback, bounded bodies, rate-limit visibility, health, and REST-only token use; **ADAPT** those behaviors to portable core and provider-specific cache/secret contracts; **REPLACE** `/ghc` as the target namespace, platform-coupled flow forks, and suffix forwarding; **DROP** scheduled cache prewarm (absent from the archived final commit), wildcard-CORS assumptions, and any claim of cache-semantic parity.

### Official platform capability snapshot (checked 2026-10-02)

| Target | Runtime / routing | Edge cache | Persistent cache | Secrets / preview | Roadmap classification |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Cloudflare Workers** | Web APIs, Workers routes/custom domains, Service Bindings, and previews are documented. [Runtime](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/) · [Routing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/routing/) · [Service Bindings](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/bindings/service-bindings/) · [Previews](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/previews/) | Cache API supported; entries are data-center local and distinct from Workers CDN caching. [Cache API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/cache/) | Workers KV is persistent/global but eventually consistent. [KV consistency](https://developers.cloudflare.com/kv/concepts/how-kv-works/) | Encrypted secret bindings supported. [Secrets](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/secrets/) | **SUPPORTED_WITH_ADAPTER**; preserve Cache API locality and KV consistency semantics. |
| **Vercel** | Use current Node.js Functions and their Web Request/Response/fetch model with Vercel routing. Do not assume the older Edge Runtime as the default; current docs recommend Node.js for general Functions. [Node.js runtime](https://vercel.com/docs/functions/runtimes/node-js) · [Edge Runtime](https://vercel.com/docs/functions/runtimes/edge) · [Project configuration](https://vercel.com/docs/project-configuration) | HTTP/CDN response caching; semantics differ from Workers Cache API. [CDN cache](https://vercel.com/docs/caching/cdn-cache) | Optional `@vercel/functions` Runtime Cache with environment isolation, tags/TTL, and documented limits. [Runtime Cache API](https://vercel.com/docs/functions/functions-api-reference/vercel-functions-package) | Environment-scoped variables/secrets and branch previews are documented. [Environment variables](https://vercel.com/docs/environment-variables) · [CDN / previews](https://vercel.com/docs/cdn) | **SUPPORTED_WITH_ADAPTER**; use Node.js Functions by default and retain Vercel-specific cache/routing contracts. |
| **Tencent EdgeOne Makers** | Makers Edge Functions use a platform handler/context and Web APIs; dynamic routes and Preview are documented. Limits are 5 MB package, 1 MB request body, and 200 ms CPU time. [Edge Functions](https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/edge-functions) · [Build guide](https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/build-guide) · [Deployment/CLI](https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/edgeone-cli) | Cache API exists, but scope/invalidation evidence is incomplete; use `CACHE_NONE` until verified. [Edge Functions](https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/edge-functions) | Makers KV is persistent and can be stale at other nodes for up to about 60 seconds. [KV](https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/kv-storage) | Environment-variable docs conflict on project-wide versus Production/Preview scope; the management API returns variable values, so protected secret handling is not established. [Makers environment variables](https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/environment-variable) | **PARTIAL**; do not enable token-backed operations until secure secret binding is verified. Do not substitute classic EdgeOne/SCDN Functions docs. |

The P5 adapter issues separate runtime route/cache/secret/package work from #98 Site static artifact packaging and staging. #99 remains Site artifact production promotion only. Any Gateway staging or production lifecycle requires its own future, explicitly authorized scope. This Roadmap correction changes Issues/Project only; Edge Gateway implementation has not started.

### Remaining P2 blocker at the time of this audit

#96 explicitly requires build jobs to set persist-credentials: false. This unmet requirement is already tracked in #96, so no duplicate Issue was opened. Keep #96 Blocked and do not close #96/#97 until the verify checkout is corrected and affected CI evidence is refreshed.
